summary: Tested audio streaming endpoint fix for expired Nhost Storage presigned URLs. All 14 backend tests passed. Frontend Audio Studio and Script Editor pages load correctly with audio clips and playback controls.
critical_code_review_comments: GET /api/audio/stream-file/{file_id} correctly returns valid WAV audio (Content-Type: audio/wav, starts with RIFF header)
Streaming endpoint correctly returns 404 for nonexistent file IDs
Streaming endpoint does NOT require auth headers (uses server-side admin secret) - correct for audio playback
script_compiler._upload_wav_to_storage returns 'nhost-file:{file_id}' format per the fix
Frontend resolveAudioUrl() in AudioStudio.js correctly handles nhost-file: format, legacy presigned URLs, and base64 data URLs
seed_data_creation: Used existing test story_45f8bef2c25c with 10 audio clips and episode ep_71379fe1575a
context_for_next_testing_agent: Audio streaming fix verified. Routes are /studio/:storyId/script and /studio/:storyId/audio. Backend test file test_audio_streaming.py covers streaming endpoint validation, content-type verification, WAV data validation, 404 handling, and URL format documentation.

backend: GET /api/audio/stream-file/{file_id} returns HTTP 200 for valid file_id (e50c796e-cb7e-4c52-9fd0-fb2017046d8b)
GET /api/audio/stream-file/{file_id} returns valid WAV audio data (RIFF/WAVE header, ~146KB)
Streaming endpoint works without Authorization header (server-side admin secret auth)
frontend: Script Editor loads at /studio/:storyId/script with dialogues, characters, and Generate Audio button
Audio Studio loads at /studio/:storyId/audio with multi-track DAW interface
Audio clips display with waveforms (Jyoti_01, Jyoti_03, Rohan_02, etc.)
Playback controls (Play, Stop, Skip back) are present

rca_of_the_issue: Root cause was confirmed: presigned Nhost Storage URLs expire (HTTP 400, x-error: signature already expired). Fix implemented: 1) Backend returns 'nhost-file:{file_id}' instead of presigned URLs, 2) New streaming endpoint /api/audio/stream-file/{file_id} proxies audio with server-side admin secret auth, 3) Frontend resolveAudioUrl() converts nhost-file: references and legacy expired presigned URLs to the streaming endpoint URL.
